answer.answer: The Gram Panchayat (GP) plays several key roles in MGNREGA registration [E01]: (1) It verifies household details including whether the household is a legitimate entity, whether applicants are local residents, and whether they are adult members [E01]. (2) The verification process must be completed within a fortnight of receiving the application [E01]. (3) Once a household is found eligible, the GP enters all particulars into the MIS (NREGASoft) system [E01]. (4) Within a fortnight of the application, the GP issues a Job Card to the eligible household [E01]. (5) Registrations are opened throughout the year at the GP office [E02].

claim_to_evidence.claim: The GP verifies household details including legitimacy of the entity, local residency, and adult membership status
Verification must be completed within a fortnight of application receipt
The GP enters eligible household particulars into the MIS (NREGASoft) system
The GP issues a Job Card to eligible households within a fortnight
Registrations are opened throughout the year at the GP office
